hook_text: Just go down there and turn by the shop. Which shop? Down where?
clip_script: Bad directions waste everyone's time. Good directions have four ingredients. One: a clear start. Leave by the main gate and face north. Two: a direction. Turn right, that is east. Three: a landmark at every turn. At the Shell garage, at the church with the red roof. Four: a distance. About three hundred metres. Don't have a tape measure? Count your steps. Around fifteen hundred steps is a kilometre, or about fifteen minutes of walking. Now put it together and anyone, a visitor, a delivery driver, even an ambulance crew, can find the way. Directions are a map made of words.
visual_style: A whiteboard confused traveller surrounded by question marks, then four icons appearing one by one: a start flag, a compass, a landmark church, a ruler; finally a clean route line from school to clinic.
pacing: Comic opener, a quick four-step list, a clear payoff.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and give directions anyone can follow.
